title: Signs of a Chemical Reaction
summary: Fizzing, colour changes, temperature changes and solids appearing: how to spot a reaction, and the famous lime-water test.

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 5: Changes Around Us: Physical and Chemical
Ch 1: Chemical Reactions and Equations (observations that show a reaction)

objectives: I can list the observable signs of a chemical reaction.
I can record careful observations when substances are mixed.
I can use the lime-water test to identify carbon dioxide.
I can distinguish exothermic (gives out heat) and endothermic (takes in heat) changes.
misconceptions: Bubbles always mean a chemical reaction (boiling water also bubbles).
If nothing seems to happen, there is definitely no reaction (some are too slow to see).
